subject: Invoice submission — communication flow and template playbook
messages:
From: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acmeco.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeCorp AP Team <ap@acmeco.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor activation — invoicing preferences & template question

Hi Hannah / Karthik,

Thanks for the onboarding call this morning. AP is ready to start sending invoices for the pilot. Before we flip the switch, two quick questions so our ERP can be configured correctly:

1) Do you prefer us to submit invoices via your supplier portal or by emailing ap@redwood.com?
2) If email is acceptable, is there a preferred subject token or attachment naming convention we should use (PO number in subject vs filename)?

I attached a quick sample of our CSV export (acmeco-invoice-template-v1.csv) for reference — would love to know if the mapping looks compatible or if you need the fields reordered.

Goal: get a single-point-of-contact and submission checklist so we don't get duplicate rejections in week 1.

Thanks,
Emily Johnson
Finance Operations Lead
AcmeCorp
[attachment: acmeco-invoice-template-v1.csv]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acmeco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor activation — invoicing preferences & template question

Hi Emily — great to meet you on the call.

Short answers up front:
- Preferred path: supplier portal is our default because it provides automated PO matching and quicker AP SLA turnaround.
- Email fallback: allowed for early pilots but please use the subject token: "PO=<PO_NUMBER>" exactly (e.g., PO=123456). That helps our parser pick up the PO reliably.

Vanessa is our vendor onboarding lead and will share the onboarding form and the minimal CSV schema we accept. Jordan is on the AP side and will confirm acceptance rules (tax fields, currency).

Next steps: Vanessa — can you send the onboarding form and a compact CSV spec. Emily — if you can upload one sample invoice to the portal this week we can run a rapid ingest test and report back. If you need temporary SMTP routing during pilot, Jordan will provide the dedicated mailbox and an acknowledgement SLA.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Procurement | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acmeco.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding form + compact invoice CSV spec (pilot)

Hi Emily — attaching the onboarding form and our compact CSV spec for the email fallback.

Summary of the playbook we've used successfully with other vendors:
- Portal-first: vendor enrolls in portal -> uploads one sample PDF/CSV with PO in portal -> automated match attempt -> human review if mismatch within 2 hours.
- Email fallback: subject line must include PO=#####; attachment must be the invoice file (PDF preferred). If sending CSV, match our compact column order: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_amount, tax_amount, currency, remit_to_entity. We prefer UTF-8 CSV with comma delimiter.
- Acknowledgements: portal shows status; email submissions receive an automated ACK within 30 minutes and a manual exception note within 4 business hours if parsing fails.

Attachment list:
- redwood-onboarding-form.pdf (fillable)
- email-fallback-csv-spec.md (compact mapping)

Couple of gotchas to note:
- If you embed multiple PO lines in one CSV row, include a line_item_id for clarity.
- For multi-entity invoices (if you bill multiple Redwood entities), please include remit_to_entity to avoid routing delays.

Emily — once you confirm, we'll enable your vendor record for the pilot and give you portal access. If you prefer to skip portal and pilot via SMTP for two weeks, Jordan will provide the mailbox + unique subject token.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-onboarding-form.pdf]

From: Emily Johnson <emily.johnson@acmeco.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeCorp AP Team <ap@acmeco.com>, Chris Lee <chris.lee@vendorco.io>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding form + compact invoice CSV spec (pilot)

Thanks Vanessa — this is perfect. A couple quick confirmations for our ERP team:
1) We'll enroll in the portal today and post a sample PDF (PO=778821) by EOD.
2) For the CSV fallback, we'll rearrange our export to match the exact column order you listed and include remit_to_entity.
3) If we hit parsing exceptions during pilot, please send the manual exception note to ap@acmeco.com and cc chris.lee@vendorco.io so we can triage quickly.

Can you confirm the PDF filename convention you'd like for portal uploads? We'll use: ACME_INV_<PO>_<INVNUM>.pdf unless you prefer something else.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to the pilot.

Emily Johnson
Finance Operations Lead
AcmeCorp
